searchText: **CONSIGNMENT** Used Heartland 5th Wheel for sale - 2018 Heartland Big Country 3155RLK is approximately 35' 10' in length with 3 slides. Features Rear Living Area King Bed Front Bedroom Kitchen Island More About This RV Imagine waking up on the weekend with a new view out the large windows, yet still enjoying all of the same comforts of home? Well, with this Heartland Big Country 3155 RLK fifth wheel you can wake up anywhere you like, and the triple slides throughout as well as all of the amenities inside will certainly bring you comforts and conveniences that resemble those you enjoy! The rear features a nice living area where you can visit with your family. Meal prep is easy in this kitchen which has an island plus there is plenty of extra counter space. When you are ready turn in for the night come find comfort at the king bed in the private bedroom. Here you will also find space in the corner wardrobe that has been prepped for a washer and dryer so now you can keep up with your laundry while you are away from home and more! Get ready to enjoy the country with a Big Country fifth wheel by Heartland. These models have a heated and enclosed underbelly which allows you to camp in all types of weather. Also along the exterior you will find large storage areas, exterior speakers, a light at the entry step, plus a six-point hydraulic level-up auto leveling system. Inside there are stained hardwood cabinets plus a deep stainless steel kitchen sink. The living room features night shades throughout to provide you the most privacy plus there is a high-output entertainment system with DVD/Bluetooth and HDMI. There are plenty of options to choose from as well as the Elite Package and the Independence Package.
